nodes.label: Oak Planks Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style oak wood planks texture. Horizontal wood-grain banding with alternating lighter and darker tan-brown strips simulating sawn wood boards. Clear horizontal seam lines divide the planks. Color palette: warm tan-brown (#B89060), medium brown (#A07840), light cream-tan (#C8A878), darker brown grain lines. Game purpose: fundamental early-game crafting and building material derived from oak logs; used for structures, tools, crafting tables, and many recipe ingredients.
nodes.pattern: horizontal plank bands with wood-grain lines and seam divisions
